items.item_text: Clinical Lab Scientist (CLS:CA): Must hold a valid California Clinical Laboratory Scientist license.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in a biological science or a U.S. military equivalent.
Experience: Completion of a 1-year internship in a hospital clinical laboratory.

Patient Testing & Accuracy: Demonstrates competency in age-specific patient testing for all populations; maintains sample integrity and patient identification throughout the analytical and reporting process.

Technical Performance & Documentation: Performs technical procedures accurately, evaluates data for reasonableness, maintains all required documentation, and authenticates results via the Laboratory Information System (LIS) prior to release.

Workflow & Quality Control: Makes appropriate decisions based on test priority and clinical needs; performs and monitors quality control for all test systems, recognizing trends and implementing corrective actions to ensure accuracy.

Equipment & Inventory Management: Prepares, calibrates, and maintains laboratory equipment; documents instrument status and manages inventory by tracking lot numbers, expiration dates, and reagent availability for subsequent shifts.

Leadership & Operational Support: Provides basic instruction for students and lab assistants, adheres to the Mission and Philosophy of the Sisters of Mercy, and performs professional customer service duties including timely phone response and patient/visitor interaction.
